text:
Frank Vatrano scored 37 goals for Anaheim in 2023-24. Three seasons later he's a part-timer: 9 games played, about 11 and a half minutes a night, and his last appearance was Nov 8 against Pittsburgh. The Ducks have played twice since without him, and nothing in our feed explains why, so we won't guess.

When he has played, the finishing has been fine: 2 goals and 3 points, from 1.25 expected goals (the quality of his chances), on a 22% shooting rate that won't last. The problem is the rest of his game. At five on five Anaheim has had 41.9% of the expected goals with him on the ice, 3 points worse than without him, and that's not new. Evolving-Hockey had him around replacement level last season (-1.1 wins), with opponents getting more chances with him out there than with almost any other forward (bottom 5%). Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking adds that he shoots plenty but fewer of those shots come from the slot than his volume suggests. Nine games is a small sample; the question is whether he gets more.
headline: Vatrano is a long way from 37 goals
